title: Si: the sparse backend on a doubled cell
summary: Bulk silicon through PAOFLOW(sparse=True), the bond-list Hamiltonian meant for large cells: the PAO Hamiltonian truncated at the 36th neighbour shell, the cell doubled along the three axes (16 atoms), its folded bands, the DOS and the Boltzmann transport tensors in one mesh pass, checked against the dense pipeline on the 2-atom cell; then the choice of the truncation and of the states solved per k-point.

qe.label: Non-self-consistent run on the full k grid
Atomic projections (read by the sparse run)

steps.label: Sparse backend: doubled cell, bands, DOS and transport, checked against the dense pipeline
steps.note: reads silicon.save (with the projwfc.x projections); writes output/ (sparse, 16 atoms) and output_dense/ (dense, 2 atoms)
